issues.explanation: The top header button and the central hero button both use identical high-visibility gold styling, creating competing primary actions that confuse user flow.
issues.location_in_image: Top-right header 'Get a Quote' button and central 'Start Your Project' button
issues.suggested_fix: Change the top-right 'Get a Quote' button to a ghost/outlined button style so 'Start Your Project' remains the single dominant primary call to action.

issues.explanation: The thin serif typeface and low brightness of the top-left logo render it faint and hard to read against the dark kitchen background image.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase font weight and adjust color brightness for the 'rehome' logo to meet a minimum 4.5:1 text contrast ratio.

issues.explanation: The light gray, thin-weight paragraph text lacks sufficient visual contrast against the dark background image, impairing readability.
issues.location_in_image: Hero body paragraph under the main headline
issues.suggested_fix: Increase the opacity and thickness of the text or apply a darker overlay gradient behind the hero content section.

issues.explanation: The navigation menu displays 'CARRIERS' instead of the conventional 'CAREERS' label, violating standard web navigation conventions and causing user confusion.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the navigation menu label text from 'CARRIERS' to 'CAREERS'.
